subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Criar poemas compostos por versos livres e de forma fixa (como quadras e sonetos), utilizando recursos visuais, semânticos e sonoros, tais como cadências, ritmos e rimas, e poemas visuais e vídeo-poemas, explorando as relações entre imagem e texto verbal, a distribuição da mancha gráfica (poema visual) e outros recursos visuais e sonoros.

components.description_pt: Compor poemas em verso livre utilizando recursos sonoros como cadência e ritmo
components.description_en: Compose poems in free verse using sound resources such as cadence and rhythm
components.cc_component_description: Identify structural elements of poems such as verse, rhythm, and meter

components.description_pt: Compor poemas em formas fixas como quadras ou sonetos observando suas convenções formais
components.description_en: Compose poems in fixed forms such as quatrains or sonnets observing their formal conventions
components.cc_component_description: Identify structural elements of poems such as verse, rhythm, and meter

components.description_pt: Aplicar recursos visuais e semânticos na composição de poemas visuais ou videopoemas
components.description_en: Apply visual and semantic resources in the composition of visual poems or video poems

components.description_pt: Explorar a relação entre imagem e texto verbal na diagramação de poema visual ou videopoema
components.description_en: Explore the relationship between image and verbal text in the graphic layout of a visual or video poem
components.cc_component_description: Explain how visual or multimedia elements contribute to the meaning of a literary text

cc_matches.description: Explain major differences between poems, drama, and prose, and refer to the structural elements of poems (e.g., verse, rhythm, meter) and drama (e.g., casts of characters, settings, descriptions, dialogue, stage directions) when writing or speaking about a text.
Analyze how visual and multimedia elements contribute to the meaning, tone, or beauty of a text (e.g., graphic novel, multimedia presentation of fiction, folktale, myth, poem).
